title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 07, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked October 07, 2026 at 22:46 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C7.9 (Peaked October 07, 2026 at 13:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 379 km/s (Moderate)

Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
